text:
maria-cs: morning — kicking off the DeltaCorp Dedicated pool bring-up thread. we need a compact runbook for quota, autoscale, and a smoke+soak load test. prefer short window (02:00-05:00 UTC). can folks ack availability?
dan-delta: DeltaCorp ok for maintenance windows. prefer Thu night. want a soft throttle before fallback to cheaper model.
sam-ops: I can draft the quota JSON. commitment is 90k req/day, expected steady 800 rps, short bursts up to 2k rps. planning reserved 3 nodes, autoscale to 6.
lee-sre: from packing math one A100-equivalent gives ~180 rps at seq64 w/ batching. 3 nodes -> ~540 rps -> need autoscale target set to reach 2k (so min 3, max 12 unless we change batch/pipeline). recommend increasing max_instances to 12 or enable cross-node batching.
anya-ml: model notes: cold kv-cache increases 1st token latency by ~18s for long-context prompts. recommend a 10-minute priming job hitting top 200 prefixes. also suggest small-quant fallback for cost control.
maria-cs: proposed schedule: Thu 02:30 UTC smoke (basic endpoints), Fri 02:00 UTC full soak + 5m spike. dan ok?
dan-delta: Thu smoke ok, Fri soak ok as long as we get post-test logs and sample fails.
sam-ops: quota draft:
- reserved_nodes: 3
- min_instances: 3
- max_instances: 12
- scale_metric: token_rate + queue_length
- burst_policy: immediate scale on sustained 30s > 70% utilization
- throttle: soft 95th pct token limit -> 0.9x request rate before fallback
- fallback_model: model-compact-v1
lee-sre: load test plan:
1) smoke (10m): 10 rps per user path, basic auth + sanity checks
2) ramp (20m): linear to 100% expected peak (2k rps)
3) soak (45m): sustain 70% peak
4) spike (5m): 150% peak
window: Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC
script snippet (k6):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'Summarize X'}), {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
}
```
run: `k6 run --vus 2000 --duration 00:50:00 script.js`
anya-ml: warmup script (bash) — hits common prefixes 3x per node:
```
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sS -X POST $ENDPOINT -d '{"prompt":"Hello summarize"}' & done
```
deploy-bot: scheduled warmup job for 2024-11-14T02:15:00Z (job id warmup-171980).
maria-cs: action items: sam finalize quota PR and include throttle config, lee publish loadscript and run commands, anya share priming list + sample capture logic, i'll send runbook to Delta.
san-ops: ack, i'll open PR to infra with autoscale policy and circuit-breaker map. link will be posted here.
lee-sre: rollback notes draft:
- stop load generator immediately
- set max_instances = min_instances = 3 to force stable state
- enable routing flag `use_fallback=true` to switch traffic to compact model
- monitor p95 and error_rate for 10m, if error_rate>3% escalate to ENG
anya-ml: post-soak QA: i'll run promptset regression (A/B) and log top 100 failing inputs to a shared folder. will report BLEU-like metrics + hallucination counts.
dan-delta: can you also capture request_ids of failures so we can link to our logs?
anya-ml: yes, will include request_id and raw input.
maria-cs: who will run the dry-run? lee?
lee-sre: I'll run Thu smoke and sanity checks, sam will validate quota changes. i'll post a one-page blameless runbook here before the smoke test.
maria-cs: final asks from Delta: 1) soft throttle at 95th pct, 2) sample failure exports, 3) a contact matrix. adding to runbook.
sam-ops: added alert rules: queue_len > 250 -> page SRE, token_error_rate > 0.5% -> page oncall, scale_delay > 60s -> page ops.
deploy-bot: reminder: create incident channel if test triggers page after 02:00 UTC.
maria-cs: good. i'll compile and send to Delta by EOD. tagging follow-ups: @sam-ops finalize PR, @anya-ml priming list + fail capture, @lee-sre loadscript + runbook. thanks team! :rocket:
